create_CocoCaptions_dataset: create a CocoCaptions dataset instance with a specified split and root directory path
read_images_and_captions: read COCO image annotations and captions from a JSON file for a given split
get_target_caption: get a random caption for a given image index from the CocoCaptions dataset
get_image_data: get the raw image bytes for a given index from the CocoCaptions dataset
get_image_relpath: get the relative file path of an image at a given index in the dataset
